description.en: Creative interactive components for React and Tailwind in shadcn format.
description.zh: 充满创意与前沿设计细节的 React 动效控件集，完全遵循 shadcn 架构。

content.en: Kokonut UI is an innovative component registry built by the Kokonut team, providing expressive, copy-paste ready React components styled with Tailwind CSS and animated via Motion. Featuring AI prompt bars, dynamic status badges, card stacks, and interactive inputs, it adds polish to SaaS products.
content.zh: Kokonut UI 是一套以高级视觉细节与生动交互见长的 React 创意组件注册表。严格遵循 shadcn 结构规范，它推出了如 AI 提示词输入胶囊、动态呼吸徽章、物理卡片堆叠与流体光效按钮等大量令人眼前一亮的原创微交互，深受现代 Web 开发者喜爱。
